population.summary_note: Largest named traditions in Pew's Indiana table are Evangelical Protestant (32%), Catholic (16%), Mainline Protestant (11%), and Historically Black Protestant (3%). Pew lists 5% atheist, 4% agnostic, and 21% nothing in particular. Figures are survey estimates and may not sum to 100% because of rounding and <1% categories.

power.summary: Three of six tracked Indiana power positions have a publicly documented religious affiliation in the sources reviewed. All three documented affiliations are Christian; the other three are left unknown, so the religious composition of the full six-position set cannot be determined.

officeholders.name: Mike Braun
officeholders.affiliation_detail: Pew/CQ Roll Call identified Braun as Catholic while he served in the U.S. Senate. The current governor biography discusses faith but does not restate a denomination.
officeholders.source_note: Affiliation documentation predates his governorship; retained as the latest high-quality direct biographical classification located in this pass.

officeholders.name: Micah Beckwith
officeholders.affiliation_detail: Official biography states he served for more than 15 years as a Worship Pastor and Campus Pastor.
officeholders.source_note: Broad Christian affiliation is supported by the official clergy biography; no denomination is assigned here.

officeholders.name: Todd Rokita
officeholders.affiliation_detail: The official biography discusses religious liberty and personal values but does not identify a religious affiliation.
officeholders.source_note: No affiliation inferred from policy positions or religious language.

officeholders.name: Todd Huston
officeholders.affiliation_detail: Current leadership biography reviewed; no religious affiliation is stated.

officeholders.name: Rodric Bray
officeholders.affiliation_detail: Current Senate Republican biography lists First United Methodist Church of Martinsville among his activities.
officeholders.source_note: Bray announced he will not seek another term as President Pro Tempore in November 2026, but remains in the role as of this snapshot date.

officeholders.name: Loretta H. Rush
officeholders.affiliation_detail: Current Indiana Judicial Branch biography reviewed; no religious affiliation is stated.
